newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy withholding tax claims can be in English.
newsitem.headline: Italy withholding tax claims can be in English.

text.p: Foreign investors wishing to claim exemption from a withholding tax on Italian government bonds from January can make their requests in English as long as all the necessary details are included, the Treasury said.
Measures abolishing the 12.5-percent tax at the source on interest on government paper will be implemented from January 1, affecting non-resident and Italian corporate investors.
The Treasury said the exemption forms can be presented to banks holding the debt instruments even before January 1 and will be valid until January 31, 1998.
The forms certifying the right to receive gross payments will have to be presented once a year.
Investors resident in tax havens or in countries that do not have double taxation treaties with Italy are not exempt from the tax.
